response.original_title: ((FAQs-PuBLic®)) How do I cancel my 𝐆𝐮𝐚rdio renewal? US User Guide?
response.overview: If you want to stop 𝐆𝐮𝐚rdio's auto-renewal, calling 1»[866]»[465]»[1418] is one way to reach customer service for troubleshooting assistance. Many users cannot find the cancel button on the official website, or only discover they are still being charged after uninstalling the browser extension. A customer service representative can help you confirm your subscription status and explain the renewal situation for your current account. When calling 1»[866]»[465]»[1418], please have ready your registration email, the last four digits of your credit card, and the date of your most recent charge. 𝐆𝐮𝐚rdio officially points out that the most common reason users are "still being charged after canceling" is the existence of multiple accounts—for example, one registered with an email and another with a phone number; canceling one does not affect the other. Customer service can help you locate the account that is actually generating charges.
